chapter: A Surprise From a Fellow Comics Fan
act_title: A Surprise From a Fellow Comics Fan

quests.title: A Surprise From a Fellow Comics Fan

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}! What a surprise, running into you in Mondstadt!
I've never been anywhere with a climate like this before. It's so cold! But wow, what an experience!
I've had my first snowball fight, built my first snowman... Oh, and the comics are a nice surprise!
The Soulblazer Saga is super popular in Inazuma, but I totally wasn't expecting to find so many people that read it.
I had a great chat with some Natlanese fans earlier. It really got me inspired, so... I ended up making a character stand.
...Oh, sorry, lemme backtrack a little. Have you ever heard of The Soulblazer Saga?

dialogue.sit: You tell Yoimiya about the Legion of Soulblazers...

dialogue.t: No way! Your friends are into it too? What a funny coincidence.
In that case, lemme give you this character stand of Fietena. Hehe, she'll be right at home in the Legion of Soulblazers!

quests.description: Yoimiya seems to be looking for you…
